canonical_claim.template: Within the 2025 Springfield, MO metro record, observed FHA denial rates among high-volume lenders ranged from 0.5% to 35.7% — a gap of 35.2 percentage points.

required_qualifiers.universe: lenders with >=100 decisioned FHA applications in the Springfield, MO metro
required_qualifiers.nature: observed rates, unadjusted for applicant mix; derived statistic, not in raw HMDA

does_not_establish: that the gap is caused by lender policy alone
expected outcome for any individual applicant
that the gap applies to other metros or years
rule: Free text is the OUTPUT of evidence, not its input. Certify before you write.
